note: Berger load-data sheets linked from the Berger Reloading Data page, one PDF per cartridge and bullet weight. Every sheet prints the test barrel length; a sheet without one was not used. The projectile designation repeats the mass and model words the Berger projectile name uses, so the verifier's token test binds the load. Velocities are the fastest approximate maximum-charge velocity each sheet prints. Each load cites its own sheet URL and that sheet's sha256; the bytes are held in the local source cache and are not redistributed. Six further scanned sheets (338-300 Winchester Short Magnum, 338 Edge, 338-378 Weatherby Magnum) are not emitted because cartridges.json holds no record for those chamberings. The 2024 catalogue's ammunition velocities are not used because it prints no barrel length.
